result.reason: The added language reaches the preferred position: Client retains ownership of its content, IP and data; Client owns Work Product created by TrueLink for it through a present assignment; embedded TrueLink IP is covered by a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence; and joint ownership is expressly disclaimed. TrueLink’s existing ownership of the Interface is preserved. The limitation permitting use, modification and sublicensing of embedded TrueLink IP as part of the Work Product in Client’s business is consistent with the intended purpose and at least meets the fallback. The amendment is targeted and professionally drafted, though the final ownership-confirmation sentence is somewhat redundant.
